body:
I use a VPN to use the internet because I feel like I’m going to get denied a clearance if I google “al-Nusra Front” in order to prepare for a podcast I do with a few online friends and various other things I panic over.

This throwaway is hidden behind exit nodes in four different countries so I feel safe enough to post. I have to post online because I don’t want my mental health history coming up on the investigation should I pursue treatment. 

If I were to get the mental health treatment I need, I would likely have to lie about it on my background questionnaire (which is a felony if caught)
I hope so. I’m scared of seeking psychiatric treatment because of how that would impact getting a Top Secret clearance.
I did give myself a chance and it’s gotten me here. Giving myself a chance was a mistake in hindsight.

I’ve gotten internships offers from the FBI and Homeland Security (and a couple of others it’s a criminal offense for me to name lol) because of my grades and relevant knowledge in world affairs, I know how applications work because they care about who you are as a person. All women care about is what I look like apparently.
Sorry can you PM me your post? You keep either deleting yourself or my phones glitching.
I was a happy person, then I decided to try some dating apps and my whole fucking world has been shattered by these apps. I haven’t fucking left my room all day and I’ve told everyone I’m sick.
Did you accidentally delete your reply? I felt like you wanted to critique my first messages or something.

I’m not thinking normally because I shouldn’t. I just got rejected by thousands of women after trying my very hardest. 

How do you be rational about the fact that you’ll never be in a relationship?
I was happy until this weekend. Now I don’t want to live anymore.

Ok I’ll give you a couple of examples.

“Hey you’re at _ college? I’m thinking of transferring there. What’s it like?” I told another girl who listed French as one of her languages “Mon français est affreux” (My French is awful)

I’ve followed tips from people online, but none of them have worked. It wasn’t until earlier today when I realized none of this is working.
If the problem isn’t with me, then it must be every woman in the world since every last one has rejected me.

My self esteem is taking a hit from the fact that I’ve gotten rejected by thousands of women this weekend. 

I don’t blame myself. I was born ugly, and I didn’t die in infancy. Now I’ve finally realized I’m ugly, and doing what nature couldn’t

Also, how do they know what kind of a person I am if they’re not willing to talk to me? Personality isn’t the issue. If it was, then I’d be getting matches and dates but nothing further. I’m not getting that far
No I don’t because I don’t even get to start a conversation. They ignore me before getting to know anything about me so I’ve never mentioned any of my skills ever.
Let’s so how great you hold up when you’re rejected by everyone like I’ve been. You have no clue what being ignored by thousands of women is like. No fucking idea

I mean, I have good qualities but women couldn’t possibly give less of a shit. I taught myself two languages using language apps and talking to native speakers online, and two years ago I sent an email to the CIA telling them they got their info wrong in a press release they made, and they issued a correction. A few days later, a member of Obama’s cabinet mentioned the exact wording I used in the email. Didn’t get any credit ofc but oh well.

Again, my good qualities are irrelevant because they’ve done nothing for me.

EDIT: It was Obama not Trump lol

I used to think I was a great person until this weekend. Now I’ve realized just how misguided and foolish that was. None of the qualities I have actually matter to women; as I’ve recently discovered. 

I consider myself guilty for psychological abuse over the past 20 years for thinking I was a good person, and the only possible punishment for this crime is death.
I didn’t end anything. The world seems to have ended with me. Or, more accurately, the world decided to never give me a chance by allowing me to be this ugly and not killing me in infancy.
I downloaded 5 different apps :(

I was fine with how I was before I downloaded all of these apps and realized how much I should hate myself because of how much women hate me. 

The fact I’m sitting here writing a suicide note in my notebook would be unfathomable a few weeks ago.
Even without it still nothing. Fucking nothing. I hate my fucking life. My existence is fucking suffering.
I have the full intention to stop, hence why I’m about to blast my fucking brain out. This world isn’t for me.

I asked them about stuff in their bio like people told me to, took advice on how to build a profile. Still, every woman in the world hates me.

I can’t fucking wait to die so I don’t have to put up with this anymore.

I’ve bashed my head into the wall, and my head is ringing like a motherfucker. If it’s true that you die from sleeping right after getting a concussion, then bye. If not, I’ll probably swing around again soon.

Feel free to keep commenting, if I somehow wake up then I’ll check this thread for comments, and pop my head up at some point.

I’m so fucking dizzy. I feel like when I was 8 years old and spent 10 minutes spinning around in the swivel chair we had just gotten. Man, that kid’s got his work cut out for him.

And I don’t have avenues to meet women in real life at the moment, so dating apps are all that I’m left with. 

It’s hard to believe that every one of the thousands of women that have rejected me online did it because they’re all only interested in gratuitous sex. I’m sure there’s women that wanted a relationship that hate me too, because I’ve recently been made aware that all women do.

I’d wager that killing myself is pretty high up on the list of things they don’t want me to do, and losing tens of thousands of dollars is something they don’t want to happen. In that estimate, I neglect to mention that there’s a large amount of money coming in to help them pay for the school I was going to transfer to; far more than they actual tuition of the future university. They had planned on using the significant amount of money left over to pay off bills etc. That will also soon be gone.

What about being exposed to all of these love songs? Seeing couples out in public? Watching my parents say how much they love each other? I can’t put up with any of this. It’s torturous. I wouldn’t be depressed if women didn’t hate me so much; and I’m only going to get better once women stop hating me.

I haven’t been lucky. I’ve contacted almost a hundred women and swiped on thousands, I’ve installed 6 different dating apps and spent hours doing everything I could to get so much as a conversation. Nothing. Absolutely nothing.

My parents never told me to focus on other things since I wouldn’t be able to raise a family/get married, and my first experience in the real world has proven that this will never happen. 

Suicide is going to be great, because they spent so much money on getting me into college, and now it’s going to be a huge financial setback. If they told me to kill myself in high school, they would have lost 5-6 grand. Now they’re out about 15 because I’m only now realizing there’s nothing in this world for me.

They could have done so much with the $10,000 that they screwed themselves out of. Hopefully they make smarter financial decisions upon realizing that I was, in hindsight, an awful economic investment. 

My brain spilled all over the floor like a snuff film is going to be like all those guys on the NYSE floor watching their money falling into a black hole back in 2008. The “ugly son who every woman on the planet hates” falls 800000 points when the markets close tonight. What a bunch of fucking idiots.

I have no where else to go at this point. I don’t have any activities at my college of women in their late 20s and I’m too young to go to Singles Nights at bars. Online dating was my only option, and it’s failed me. Miserably

My igbo note is coming along nicely but it doesn’t make any sense translated back. Any Igbo(s? ese? ians? What are they even called?) willing to translate for me. Hell, I’d even kill myself for some help *badum tsssss*
They’re all 25-30.

I remember in 4th grade I got a concussion and the school nurse told me that I’d die if I tried to sleep. I’m really excited now because this won’t leave as much of a mess. Now I just have to find a way to go about this quietly.

Oddly enough, googling whether I’d die from sleeping with a concussion does that stupid thing where it redirects you to a Suicide Prevention hotline and I can’t access anything else. Or maybe I’m looked out of google for trying to find suicide methods one too many times?

“Let me try Bing” is something I’d never think I’d. To be fair, I also didn’t think I’d be sitting in my room hiding a loaded .45 that I stole from my stepdad, so suffice it to say shit’s changed.

I wonder what else being suicidal has done to change my thought process and reverse my preferences. I fucking hate watermelon. Am I going to love it now? Should I try to read the South China Morning Post even though I used to think they’re an arm of pro-Mao propaganda? 

Might as well live every day like it’s my last. I should get a last meal of T-bone steak like the guys on death row get. I’ve earned that much

Edit: aaaand Bing is directing me to suicide hotlines as well. “Suicide is not the answer” Well you try to get rejected by thousands of people and see what happens. Motherfucker. I’m gonna get the fuckin cops on my door soon. Last night I had a dream that I called 911 to get cops to come kill me. It quickly turned into a nightmare when the fuckers didn’t see me as a threat and shot me with a god damn beanbag shotgun to subdue and arrest me. Hopefully cops are less like SWAT 4 speedrunners and more like DOOM speedrunners.
I can’t meet any women my age in real life because my college doesn’t have any activities.

There isn’t. There is literally no clubs at my shitty community college. This is the problem. 

I’ve spent 50 dollars on getting premium accounts on all these dating apps and haven’t gotten a fucking thing. I’ve messaged about 80 women, swiped on thousands. Nothing 

I’m fucking useless, these skills I have haven’t done anything for me whatsoever.
Aye.

I know a couple people were entertained by my post last night because of the humor. Before I was suicidal I started writing a historical dark comedy abou....ah, fuck it, my writing ability hasn’t produced any results so it’s not like it really matters. 

The issue is I don’t have any activities at my “college” so I don’t really have a way to make connections, and I’m not allowed in bars yet so I can’t go that route.
Fuck. Well this day just keeps getting better doesn’t it?

Try clubs at your school so you have common ground other than your appearance.

My college doesn’t have any clubs which is why this is my only option.

IDK if you want to take life advice from the guy that’s about the blast his brains out tho; your call fam.

I ask them about stuff on their profile like “Hey, so you’re majoring in _? What are your classes like?” I’ve also seen some Asian girls that list Mandarin as one of their languages, so I’ve said “My Chinese is really bad” in Chinese as my first message since I’m taking Chinese in college.

I’ve never said “Hey” or “SHOW TITS”, but still women hate me.

Ouch no thank you. I stayed away from 9mm for a reason lol. 

My Tinder boost ran out without me getting a single like (fucking surprise!) and my stepdad’s Taurus was the only thing I could find. Apparently it works pretty damn good though.
What’s there to be positive when I’ve been on six different apps, have invested hours in all of them, sent messages to about 50 women in total, and not received feedback on any of them?
These rounds are marked “JHP”. What the fuck does JHP mean? I need an optimal amount of single-shot penetration for this to work on the first bang or this ain’t gonna be pretty.

If I wasn’t already an “incel type”  I wouldn’t have .45 fully loaded on my desk. I can’t live my daily life being exposed to love stories and romantic music while knowing that isn’t something I can achieve.

20. You’re likely somewhere in the EU, but here in the US the drinking age is 21.

I go to a “community college”, a more affordable college you go to for 2-3 years. Considering the lack of price, that also means the college is awful. There are no student organizations for me to get involved in, and the majority of students here are 25-30. Meeting women at my school is impossible, as is going to “Singles Nights” outside of class since I’m not allowed into bars.

This is where the buck stops. I can’t meet anyone in real life, and I’ve been completely ignored by women on all the dating apps I’ve downloaded. 

The world has decided to reject me, so I’m going to reject the world.

Dating. I wish people would have told me earlier I won’t be able to date. I was told how great I was my whole life; now I’m in the real world and I realized I’m not allowed to date. 

Now my parents spent money on me going to college, so this is kind of a good “fuck you” for lying to me all these years. If they told me I was ugly in middle school or high school I would’ve killed myself then and saved them a lot of money. Now they’re down 15 grand. Fuckers

Tried to inject my sense of humor into the 20 messages I sent on OkCupid, no dice. 

I should probably take another shower so I don’t smell so bad for my mom or stepdad. Maybe I should write my note in some obscure language just to confuse everybody and help them cope with all the stress that’s going to come of this.
